title: Drawing on the Powers of Heaven: The Nature and Function of Faith
summary: Explore the specific types of faith required to invoke divine assistance in everyday life, as outlined in Grant von Harrison's book, 'Drawing on the Powers of Heaven.' This message breaks down Joseph Smith's teachings on faith as a principle of action versus a principle of power, emphasizes the critical role of collective faith within missionary companionships, and challenges listeners to move past general belief into specific, everyday spiritual leverage.
